notes:
42 foods coded (21 cool / 21 warm / 0 neutral). Source is a 五性 (熱性・温性・平性・涼性・寒性) explainer; it never assigns 平性/neutral to any specific food, so no neutral rows.

NOT coded, with reasons:
- チョコレート (L106 heading 「チョコレートは体を冷やすのか」): the source never states chocolate itself has a cooling nature. It says the 白砂糖 it contains is 体を冷やす食材 (coded), and that its カカオポリフェノール helps circulation / 冷え対策 (L110). Coding チョコレート=cool would be inference. FLAGGED: a mechanical extractor is likely to emit チョコレート=cool from the heading — that would be wrong per §3.
- 洋菓子 (L109): mentioned only as another product containing 白砂糖; no nature attributed.
- スパイス白湯 (L104-105 related-article blurb): prepared beverage, not a food's nature (§8 kracie 白湯/生姜湯 precedent). Also no explicit warm/cool label.
- 生姜 (L87, related-article blurb 「生姜は代表的な体温め食材です」): same food as しょうが already coded from the main list (L84); not duplicated as a separate row. Note the verbatim form 生姜 does occur at L87 if a 生姜-keyed row is preferred.
- もやし/ツナ (L120 related-article title 「体ポカポカ『もやしとツナの生姜ナムル』レシピ」): recipe title, no nature attribution.
- ゆず (L124), 陳皮/みかんの皮 (L126), ネギ (L121/L132 article titles), 蒸し生姜 (L130): sidebar article titles only, no direction stated. (ねぎ is separately coded warm from the main list at L82.)
- Descriptor-only lines in the two 特徴 lists — 夏が旬のもの / 暑い地域でとれる食材 / 地面より上にできるもの (L36-38), 冬が旬のもの / 寒い地域でとれる食材 / 地面より下にできる野菜 (L44-46): these are provenance/growing-condition rules, not food or food-category labels, so not coded.

BORDERLINE inclusions (umbrella/category labels, coded per the category rule — flagging so the adjudicator can drop them if the umbrella scope is narrower than intended):
- 葉物野菜 (cool, L63) — attributed via 「体を冷やす食材は…白・青・緑（冷色）の葉物野菜が豊富です」. Note the source's own cooling vegetable list includes キャベツ/白菜/ほうれんそう/小松菜, consistent with this.
- 根菜類 (warm, L85) — 「体を温める食材は…土の中で育つ根菜類があります」.
- 香辛料 (warm, L99) — appears both as a list item and in prose.
- 発酵食品 (warm, L48/L50/L103) — genuine food category, stated three times.
- 精製された食品 (cool, L39/L41) and 未精製の食品 (warm, L47/L50) — these sit in the 特徴 lists and are processing-state categories rather than named foods; they are the weakest of the borderline set. Direction is explicitly stated for both.

Direction vocabulary used by the source is 体を冷やす / 体を温める throughout (plus the 五性 framing at L30); mapped per §3.
